results.pair_summary: Doc A defines the formal constitution, types, operations, and invariants for the R2.0-C Observability Runtime. Doc B serves as a freeze report confirming ABI stability and implementation details for the same layer.
results.integration_rationale: Doc A establishes the canonical semantic contract and correctness invariants for Delta3 Kernel observability. Doc B captures version-specific implementation details (ABI, SBCL environment) and release status. Merging would conflate architectural design with transient release artifacts; maintaining both ensures traceability from formal requirements to frozen delivery.
